search-nodes.title: Nodes Explored per Move
search-nodes.description: Total chess positions evaluated by the engine for each move. Opening/middlegame/endgame phases should appear visually distinct based on node counts.

queries.query: SELECT attributes->>'chess.total_nodes' AS nodes, attributes->>'chess.best_move' AS best_move, attributes->>'chess.fen' AS position, timestamp FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE service_name = 'chess-engine-service' AND name = 'agent.decide_move' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

search-duration.title: Engine Search Duration (ms)
search-duration.description: Time taken by the C++ engine to search and return the best move. Spikes indicate complex positions.

queries.query: SELECT attributes->>'chess.total_duration_ms' AS duration_ms, attributes->>'chess.best_move' AS move, timestamp FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE service_name = 'chess-engine-service' AND name = 'agent.decide_move' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

pruning-efficiency.title: Pruning Efficiency (Alpha-Beta Cutoffs)
pruning-efficiency.description: Number of alpha-beta pruning events per search. Higher values indicate better move ordering and more effective search.

queries.query: SELECT attributes->>'engine.pruning_events' AS prunes, attributes->>'engine.best_move' AS move, attributes->>'engine.depth_reached' AS depth, timestamp FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE service_name = 'chess-engine-service' AND name = 'engine.search' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tt-hit-rate.title: Transposition Table Hit Rate
tt-hit-rate.description: Percentage of TT lookups that returned a cached evaluation. Higher is better — means the TT is avoiding re-searching transposed positions.

queries.query: SELECT attributes->>'engine.tt_hit_rate' AS hit_rate, attributes->>'engine.tt_entries' AS entries, attributes->>'engine.best_move' AS move, timestamp FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE service_name = 'chess-engine-service' AND name = 'engine.search' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

llm-cost-latency.title: LLM Coach Agent: Cost & Latency
llm-cost-latency.description: Per-explanation cost (USD) and response latency from the Anthropic Claude API. Tracks token consumption over time.

queries.query: SELECT attributes->>'llm.cost_usd' AS cost_usd, attributes->>'llm.latency_ms' AS latency_ms, attributes->>'llm.total_tokens' AS tokens, attributes->>'chess.best_move' AS move, timestamp FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE service_name = 'chess-coach-agent' AND name = 'llm.generate_explanation' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

eval-distribution.title: Evaluation Score Distribution
eval-distribution.description: Distribution of engine evaluation scores across moves. Shows whether the engine is finding advantageous or equal positions.

queries.query: SELECT attributes->>'engine.eval_score' AS eval_score, attributes->>'engine.best_move' AS move, timestamp FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE service_name = 'chess-engine-service' AND name = 'engine.search' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

trace-waterfall.title: Agent Decision Trace Waterfall
trace-waterfall.description: Full span hierarchy for each agent.decide_move call: search → evaluation → transposition lookup → coach explanation. Shows the complete reasoning pipeline.

queries.query: SELECT name, duration, attributes->>'chess.best_move' AS move FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE service_name IN ('chess-engine-service', 'chess-coach-agent') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

name: Glass Box Chess - Agent Observability Dashboard
description: Full observability dashboard for the Glass Box Chess AI agent. Tracks search performance, pruning efficiency, TT utilization, LLM costs, and the complete decision-making trace.
